record.question:
You have been made responsible to hire boats at a short notice to be used for an area under flood. On
    seeing the price mentioned by the boat owners, you found that the lowest price was approximately three
    times more than the approved rate of the Government. You would:
options:
reject the proposal and immediately escalate the matter to higher authorities, requesting urgent
          intervention and official instructions.
accept the lowest price as it is urgent.
make temporary verbal commitments with boat owners, hoping to resolve the pricing issue later.
threaten the boat owners about a possible cancellation of the license.
